component.name: DonutStudio
component.summary: Harmonic composition workstation and MIDI editor

description.p: DonutStudio is a software created by DonutsDelivery starting December 2025. It's goal is to bring the world a functional way of working with just intonation harmony through direct mathematical ratios between nodes in an and uncluttered way which was achieved through a constant iterative relationship between human trial and AI-assisted coding that was also inspired by formats from the xenharmonic community.

DonutStudio has besides its narrower plugin version become a fully fletched Audio and Video workstation with a rich downloadable library to easily gather free resources from, direct per-note audio manipulation, audio recording, per note-pitch shifting, global modulation, stem seperation, audio-to-midi support, harmony and chord tools, VST3 plugin support, Built-in Synths and Airwindows effects, synthetic vocal creation, scripting and hardware support as some of its DAW features.

The video editor includes 3d graphics engine with path tracing, frame interpolation and beat-syncing, subtitle generation, social media publishing, and advanced media creation. Both sides of the workstation offer modular backbones for everything. DonutStudio can be driven by modern AI agents through its MCP-server. Not as single line of its code was written by a human.

DonutStudio and its features are free but offers a Pro license registrations to unlock various advanced options across those features that are labeled in a purple coating throughout the interfaces. Some specific addons such as social publishing, Symbolic AI (experimental), and Vocal Synthesis are Pro-only.
